clue.text: A weapon attached to a rifle, perhaps

definitions.meaning: a strap-and-pouch device for hurling stones, as David used
the carrying strap fixed to a rifle so it hangs from the shoulder

explanation.definitionFit: One word names both a stone-throwing weapon and the shoulder strap fastened to a gun.

clue.text: Is of use when lava is erupting

explanation.definitionFit: To be of benefit or use is to serve a purpose, the verb's core meaning.

parts.note: reads as lodging for hapless seamen, but means the cheapest passenger quarters on a ship, for those who travel poorly-off

definitions.meaning: a liveried household servant who waits at table or opens doors
whimsically, a man who deals with feet, a foot specialist

indicators.note: signals that the letters could be rearranged into something else

explanation.definitionFit: The waters between Britain and Norway have long been a major commercial fishery.

indicators.note: something gone bad is spoilt, so these letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Someone plotting revenge vows to ruin a rival's reputation in the press.

clue.text: Part of the plans for promotion

definitions.meaning: an architect's drawing showing one face of a building
being raised to a higher rank or station

clue.text: He sculpted a man embracing a girl

clue.text: Love to go to bar in Scotland

to bar is to forbid or prohibit

explanation.surface: A romantic heads to the pub north of the border.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bar' looks like a pub but is the verb meaning prohibit; the definition is simply a place found in Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: A west-coast port town and ferry terminal lies in Argyll, a Scottish region.

clue.text: Short of cash in inn, I'd get thrown out

definitions.meaning: the flour, egg and milk mix from which Yorkshire pudding is made

clue.text: Like to get a first-class return for the continent

explanation.definitionFit: The largest landmass on Earth, stretching from Turkey to Japan.

definitions.note: the definition is a noun phrase; the answer is an adjective (or noun) describing someone who professes not to know of the divine

definitions.meaning: a grammatical tense for continuous past action
factory seconds are slightly flawed goods

clue.text: A lot of impetus is lost turning two directions

definitions.meaning: to diminish or reduce, as subtract
a shop selling cooked food to be eaten elsewhere, Chinese being a common kind

explanation.definitionFit: To twine or encircle, as a garland coils round something.

clue.text: One girl I converted to the faith

definitions.meaning: to move on, to go ahead

parts.note: reads as a radio operator's identifier, but means made a gesture summoning someone

indicators.note: the make-up of something is how it is put together, here reassembled letters

clue.text: It's bound to mean a change of plea

clue.text: Poles strangely under a certain inclination

indicators.note: one piece goes round the other, so the word Is surrounds the second

clue.text: A past love, far from extinguished

explanation.surface: Feelings for an ex-lover still burn.
explanation.walkthrough: A plus FLAME, as in an old flame.
explanation.definitionFit: On fire, blazing, the opposite of put out.

clue.text: Very good article for cake decoration
